headline: Gasly says Alpine's tyre overheating cost Singapore points
body: Gasly finished 11th after starting seventh in Singapore. He says Alpine's tyres overheated within three laps of a stint, leaving him short of traction out of slow corners. Hadjar took the final point as Gasly's pace fell away late in the race.

headline: Bottas sees Cadillac improving its operations each weekend
body: Bottas says Cadillac is improving how it operates in different areas each weekend, although the progress has yet to show in its results. The team remains without a point in its first Formula 1 season. He also rates its facilities above those he knew at Mercedes.
